references.label: ALIEN targets
references.description: Complete the ALIEN standups. Favor controlled or incidental hits over direct center rebounds.

references.label: Alien Star saucer
references.description: Complete ALIEN, use the spinner to select 5x, then start two-ball play at the left saucer. During multiball, repeat the spinner and use the right return lane for short 10x spinner windows.

references.label: return lane
references.description: Complete ALIEN, use the spinner to select 5x, then start two-ball play at the left saucer. During multiball, repeat the spinner and use the right return lane for short 10x spinner windows.

references.label: right-lane
references.description: Use the right-lane feed only when the spinner follow-up is already available.

references.label: Center spinner
references.description: Alien Star uses A-L-I-E-N to qualify two-ball play and the spinner to select its scoring multiplier. Choose 5x before starting two-ball play, repeat the spinner while protected, and shoot it immediately after a right-return-lane feed activates the brief 10x window.
